This is probably reflected in the data over large sample sizes as a larger difference, as most gamers go with Intel and a small percentage deliberately play games that are optimized for one or the other. That trend is shifting though and laptops are starting to go all-in on AMD.

I don't think the numbers are fudged, they just reflect minor differences factoring in to skew larger differences over a mass of sampled data.
